prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, new_flow] Waiting screen preview sub-flow: Adds an interactive companion preview sub-screen while waiting for pet generation to keep users engaged during long rendering times.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Preparing your desktop pet", "body": "Your pet is being customized. Preview how it will live on your desktop below."}, "new_wait_preview": {"headline": "Pet interaction preview", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "animation", "style": "playful", "action": "play"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "new_wait_preview", "home_intro"]}
1: [sign_in, redesign] Compact mascot sign-in redesign: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a compact card layout with mascot reassurance about cloud saving.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Save your pet companion to the cloud", "body": "Sign in to keep your adopted pet safe and accessible across all your computers.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "text": "Your pet will be saved to your account!"}]}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after pet rendering wait: Moves sign-in screen to occur right after pet rendering completes, right before the final intro.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"]}
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop controls checklist redesign: Rebuilds the home intro screen into a full bleed layout featuring an interactive desktop controls checklist.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Your pet is live on your desktop!", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "style": "rounded", "text": "Click pet to interact • Right-click for options • Drag to relocate"}]}}
4: [choose_path, copy] Fast pet creation path headline: Updates choose_path copy to emphasize that creating or choosing a pet takes less than 1 minute.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Pick your pet path in under 60 seconds", "body": "Select a ready-to-play companion or create a custom pet from your own photos."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen timer and progress indicators: Enables explicit time estimates and step progress counter on the rendering wait screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_step_counter": true, "body": "Crafting your pet desktop avatar. This typically takes 1-2 minutes."}}
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption certificate mascot highlight: Adds an official adoption badge and companion mascot to the pick friend screen.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "style": "highlight", "text": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate Included"}, {"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "text": "Pick me to be your new desktop companion!"}]}}
7: [choose_path, new_screen] Pre-path overview intro screen: Inserts a short overview screen explaining what desktop pets do before asking users to choose a path.
   config: {"new_pet_overview": {"headline": "Meet your virtual desktop companion", "body": "Desktop pets roam your screen, react to your activity, and keep you company while you work.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "animation", "style": "calm", "action": "play"}]}, "_order": ["story", "new_pet_overview", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
8: [finish, hint] Desktop tray display shortcut hint: Adds a high-visibility hint on home_intro detailing how to recall the pet if it disappears.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "If your pet wanders off screen, click the system tray icon to recall it immediately."}}
9: [adoption, layout] Centered photo upload layout with guidance: Changes photo upload screen to a centered layout with clear photography guidelines.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "centered", "hint": "Upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward for optimal 3D pet generation results."}}

verdicts.reason: Adds a valid preview sub-screen during pet rendering wait within onboarding limits.
Redesigns sign-in screen while maintaining its required function and onboarding scope.
Reorders sign-in to occur after pet rendering, which is explicitly allowed by rule 4.
Redesigns home_intro with desktop controls checklist while preserving its original function.
Updates choose_path copy while retaining both adoption and creation paths without introducing dark patterns.
Adds step counter and time estimate to waiting screen during actual pet rendering wait.
Adds official badge and mascot to pick_friend screen without introducing price or gift mentions.
Adds a valid overview screen inside onboarding before path selection.
Adds a helpful shortcut hint to home_intro within onboarding boundaries.
Redesigns photo upload screen with centered layout and helpful photography guidance.
